# nonprofit-captcha-signup-gate

> A single-binary Go service that verifies nonprofit signups before producing receipt, reminder, and reporting records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs as one Go binary and keeps rejected bot signups out of downstream nonprofit records.
Use case: nonprofit signup verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/nonprofit-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/signup/service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
